item.text: I’ll inspect the stripe colors and compare them with the videos’ visual palettes.

/bin/zsh -lc "python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
from collections import Counter
im=Image.open('barcode.png').convert('RGB')
print(im.size)
p=[im.getpixel((x,100)) for x in range(im.width)]
print('mean',tuple(round(sum(c[i] for c in p)/len(p),1) for i in range(3)))
for a in range(0,1000,100):
 q=p[a:a+100]; print(a,tuple(round(sum(c[i] for c in q)/len(q),1) for i in range(3)))
print(Counter(p).most_common(12))
PY"
